caveats: This is a publication census, not source-certification of each mechanical field.
Scavenger PDF native text provides page-anchored extraction crosscheck; not every full statblock has been individually visually certified.
Model families and named character statblocks can refer to one underlying droid template; do not sum as unique factories.
PDF/txt OCR may corrupt component names and field values; raw OCR-derived systems and possessions are provisional only.
Several Scavenger Codex listings contain both a full character/vehicle statblock and protocol format; one listing each.

The original 17-slot target has three unmatched unverified placeholders. Published Saga Edition bibliographies enumerate 14 WotC rule/sourcebooks, all 14 supplied and now census-reviewed; the other three were never identified books. Additional Dawn of Defiance/web/adventure/source materials require a separately identified expansion scope, not a fabricated zero listing.

SGD DP-2 is a vehicle-format droid. Its proposed consumer is the existing V2 vehicle pipeline, but a specific production DP-2 mapping was not confirmed in the examined default-branch repository. Do not claim existing model-specific certification.

KOTOR: 24 full source identities found including 16 in main Chapter V, two Sith assault droids, the vehicle-format Basilisk, named GO-TO/HK-47/T3-M4 and two final Krath/Rakatan droids; page IDs verified against image-only PDF. The table-of-contents, narrative and repeated captions are not additional statblock listings. Field-level numerical certification remains pending.

CLONE: 40 publication-specific statblocks found across equipment, squad, Republic, Confederacy, vehicle and starship chapters. The Ground Armored Tank is included because its published Crew is a droid brain; the Hyena is explicitly a droid-starship variant with Crew 0. Five other explicit droid-name vehicle entries are also counted. These seven remain under vehicle authority, pending identity reconciliation.

CLONE: B1-Series Battle Droid Squad is a published squad-aggregate statblock, not a factory model or an extra physical droid. Group-derived Large size and stats must not be treated as a Large chassis construction cost. No mechanical fields were certified by this identity census.

CLONE: printed page mapping confirmed by PDF visual locator (PDF page 1-based = printed page + 1). Main OCR headings with ambiguous glyphs were verified visually; some exact CL and class-level numerical fields need a separate source certification pass.

CLONE: inclusive-count convention includes the Ground Armored Tank because Crew droid brain (expert) and the autonomous-control prose expressly establish a droid-operated vehicle; the 39 count excluding GAT is retained for alternate categorization. Other non-droid vehicles with organic crew, passengers, or merely droid-assisted functions are excluded.

FORCE: 11 ordinary droid-character publication statblocks, 6 in equipment chapter and 5 in Imperial chapter; PDF (image-only) printed page labels directly checked, 1-based PDF index = printed page + 1. Separate source heading from scanned statblock heading when different (BD-3000). Independent Droid prestige and talents are rules, not another statblock; Phase Zero Dark Trooper is a Human cyborg with some droid-system permissions, not a droid. No full mechanical certification claimed.

FORCE: three junk droid variants do not print a degree in their statblocks; do not fill degree from chapter grouping without a source rule. Junk droids not for sale have estimated values only; no seller price. R-1 integrated blaster must reconcile narrative and Possessions field; PROXY Jedi levels and Force 2 are printed but do not imply Force Sensitivity. Mechanic-specific validation remains outstanding.

GOI: eight statblocks, all droid actor format, source pages visually checked. M4/FIII OCR interleaves columns; PDF isolates source identities. NR-1100 narrative unarmed vs listed blaster remains unresolved. 3D-4 stock-unarmed narrative vs listed concealed hold-out suggests model/base-vs-presented loadout distinction. Named FIII units Fidelis/Solis and A7-E3PO have no distinct statblocks. Source identities attested; field-level mechanics outstanding.

JATM: 0 published droid-statblock identities in a 15,100-line full-book TXT sweep; relevant Iron Knights/Shard (printed pp.78-79) and subelectronic converter (p.64) rules were checked on PDF pages 79-80 and 65. The zero count does not imply no droid-related rules. JATM Shard species is not an ordinary droid, and mind-affecting immunity exceptions attach to the entitled attacker or explicit Force talent rather than changing every defender. Per-rule mechanical certification remains outstanding.

LEGACY: LV8 has no printed degree in its statline although located under fourth-degree heading; record degree=null and section-implied degree=4 separately. PI is an OCR ambiguity corrected by visual PDF. Neither changes listing count. Replica Droid PC rules exist in Threats of the Galaxy and remain to be certified in that publication pass.
